goldens.comment: Unsafe raw List deserialization without type safety. Calling Optional.get() directly on the Optional returned by RecoveryAuthnCodesUtils.getCredential(user) without checking isPresent() can lead to a NoSuchElementException if the Optional is empty.
goldens.reasoning: C1 covers the unchecked Optional.get() that can throw NoSuchElementException. C6 covers the raw List deserialization, which the golden comment also mentions.

goldens.comment: After creating the RecoveryAuthnCodesCredentialModel, consider setting its id from the stored credential (e.g., myUser.recoveryCodes.getId()); otherwise getId() will be null and downstream removal by id (e.g., removeStoredCredentialById in the authenticator flow) may not work.
goldens.reasoning: No candidate mentions that the credential model's id is never set from the stored credential, which would break removal by id.

candidates: Optional.get() called twice via getNextRecoveryAuthnCode().get() will throw NoSuchElementException if credential is missing or has no remaining codes - should handle empty cases explicitly with orElseThrow
credentialType.equals(...) can throw NPE if called with null credentialType - should use constant-first equals pattern

updateCredential persists plaintext recovery codes list (JSON) into user storage provider instead of hashed data, which is a security regression - should store hashed RecoveryAuthnCodesCredentialModel data instead
Javadoc grammar error: 'a optional credential model' should be 'an optional credential model'
Typo in alias value: 'delayed-suthenticator-config' appears unintentional and makes it harder to search/maintain flow config

JsonSerialization.readValue(..., List.class) loses element type and forces raw types, and catch block drops exception details - should use TypeReference<List<String>> and include exception when logging
Recovery codes validator accepts any matching code without consuming it, allowing the same recovery code to be replayed indefinitely and out-of-order codes to work - codes should be one-time use
